about_the_game:
About the Game:

In Capsoul, you play as Capster — a brave capsule armed with nothing but quick reflexes, stylish boots, and an unshakable mustache.
Thornark, a twisted being of darkness, has stolen a powerful artifact, and it’s up to Capster to chase him down across treacherous lands, dodge deadly traps, and defeat monstrous foes.

Key Features:

  • Precise, fast-paced 3D platforming action

  • Low-poly vibrant worlds filled with secrets and hazards

  • Intense boss battles, including chaotic rocket-throwing demons and swarms of angry bees

  • A light-hearted but challenging experience, perfect for players who love skill-based platformers

  • A hero you won’t forget — with a mustache that refuses to quit

What’s in the Demo:

  • A glimpse into Capster's wild journey

  • Handcrafted platforming levels designed to test your skills

  • A sample boss fight against one of Thornark’s minions

  • The first taste of an epic quest fueled by heart, humor, and one glorious mustache

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Window 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 или AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti или AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Window 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 или AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti или AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Capsy - a cheeky capsule with a moustache and stylish shower cap - faces ruthless Thornark in a fateful showdown. In this hardcore platformer with scarce lives, master diverse weapons and slick abilities to overcome relentless challenges. Precision, danger, and a touch of madness await!
